name: LevelSet
description: A level set description of particle shape based on a discrete distance field<LevelSet.distField> (denoting $\phi$ the underlying signed distance function) and surface nodes<LevelSet.surfNodes> [Duriez2021a]_ [Duriez2021b]_. See :ysrc:`examples/levelSet` for example scripts.

attributes.name: distField
attributes.description: The signed (< 0 when inside) distance-to-surface function as a discrete scalar field on lsGrid, with distField[i][j][k] corresponding to lsGrid.gridPoint(i,j,k). From Python, slice this multi-dimensional list with care: while distField[i][:][:] corresponds to values on a x-cst plane, distField[:][:][k] is not at z-constant (use [[distField[i][j][k] for j in ..] for i in ..] instead)

attributes.name: corners
attributes.description: The 8 corners of an axis-aligned bounding box, in local axes. It is computed once for all by

attributes.name: surfNodes
attributes.description: Surface discretization nodes (the list of) used for exact contact treatment in Ig2_LevelSet_LevelSet_ScGeom, previously coined boundNodes in (Duriez2021b). Expressed in local frame. Getting them back after a save/load cycle requires to launch one iteration or to first ask for shape.center.

attributes.name: neighborsNodes
attributes.description: Denoting n_neighborsNodes as $N$, neighborsNodes[i] is a $N+1$ elements iterable with i as the first item, then the indices of the $N$ closest neighbor nodes for every surface node i, ordered by increasing distance wrt to i.

attributes.name: n_neighborsNodes
attributes.description: How many closest nodes we want to store for every one in neighborsNodes (i.e., the $N$ therein). A negative value leaves the latter uncomputed i.e. empty

attributes.name: sphericity
attributes.description: Shape sphericity computed from boundary nodes and assuming both largest inscribed sphere and smallest circumscribed sphere have the origin (of local axes) as center.

attributes.name: starLike
attributes.description: Indicates whether surface nodes are ray-traced considering that a ray can intersect the surface no more than once.

attributes.name: lsGrid
attributes.description: The regular grid carrying distField, in local axes.

attributes.name: twoD
attributes.description: True for z-invariant shapes. Serves to restrict the ray tracing of

attributes.name: smearCoeff
attributes.description: Rules the smearing coefficient $ varepsilon > 0$ of the Heaviside step function for a smooth integration of the particle's volume close to its surface (the higher $ varepsilon$ the smoother, i.e. the more diffuse the surface in terms of volume integration). Given in reciprocal multiples of $R_{cell} = sqrt{3}/2 g_{grid}$ the half diagonal of the cells of the lsGrid with $g_{grid}$ the cell length: $ varepsilon = R_{cell} times 1/$ *smearCoeff* (smearing is deactivated if negative).

attributes.name: hasAABE
attributes.description: Flag to indicate whether an axis-aligned bounding ellipsoid (AABE) has been provided by the user. If true, you must specify axisAABE. Only works for VLS-DEM.

attributes.name: axesAABE
attributes.description: The half lengths of the principal axes of the axis-aligned bounding ellipsoid (AABE) of the level-set shape. Format (rx,ry,rz). Only works for VLS-DEM.

attributes.name: wire
attributes.description: Whether this Shape is rendered using color surfaces, or only wireframe (can still be overridden by global config of the renderer).

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Whether this Shape will be highlighted when rendered.

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: binarize
methods.description: Returns (for any user-defined purpose) a voxellised description of the shape volume. Selection (as being part of the particle) of voxels associated with a strictly zero value of distance depends on *surface*. :param bool surface: whether to consider particle surface voxels (with a zero distance value) as being part of the volume (if True) or not (if False) :returns: a 3D grid of 0/1 integers whose [i][j][k] term is 1, resp. 0, when the voxel associated to lsGrid.gridPoint(i,j,k) (see volume for an exact definition of that association) is inside, resp. outside, the particle. Modulo *surface* considerations, the returned 0/1 values actually correspond to $( phi-| phi|)/(2 phi)$

methods.name: volume
methods.description: A 2025/09-deprecated version of getVolume<LevelSet.getVolume>. Please use the latter instead.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Returns the shape volume as the negative domain of the level set function, in a voxellised fashion, where a negative value of the level set, distField[i][j][k] $ leq$ 0, is considered to correspond to a material cubic voxel of side lsGrid.spacing and centered at lsGrid.gridPoint(i,j,k). Smearing considerations may apply as per smearCoeff.

methods.name: center
methods.description: The center of mass of the volume<LevelSet.volume> (considering obviously an uniform density for this volume), in local axes (for verification purposes, by comparison with the origin).

methods.name: inertia
methods.description: The diagonal coefficients (i.e., eigenvalues, in a consistent workflow) of the geometric inertia matrix (the one considering the infinitesimal volume as the integrand, instead of infinitesimal mass) of the particle volume<LevelSet.getVolume>, as a (xx,yy,zz) Vector3r.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Distance to surface at *pt*, with pt being expressed in the local frame. The 'unbound' flag (if True) allows the computation of distance values outside of the grid<LevelSet.lsGrid> extents, which otherwise returns NaN together with an error.

methods.name: normal
methods.description: Unit normal vector to the surface, at some pt. Local frame applies to both output normal and input pt. Has an 'unbound' flag signaling whether to allow (if True) the computation of the normal outside of the grid<LevelSet.lsGrid> extents.

methods.name: assignSurfNodes
methods.description: Assigns given *nodes* (as a list of Vector3r points conforming local frame) to surfNodes, erasing pre-existing ones if any.

methods.name: rayTrace
methods.description: Performs one ray tracing along *ray* (to be given in cartesian coordinates, see spher2cart() if a conversion is useful from spherical ones; norm should not matter) and returns the obtained surface points (without modifying surfNodes<LevelSet.surfNodes>). Argument *nodesTol* has the same meaning as in rayTraceSurfNodes<LevelSet.rayTraceSurfNodes>, see therein. Provided for debugging or shape analysis purposes.

methods.name: rayTraceSurfNodes
methods.description: Defines all surface nodes (i.e., surfNodes) by ray tracing, erasing pre-existing ones if any, according to given arguments :param int nSurfNodes: how many rays are to be launched. Please use a perfect square + 2 if not twoD and if *nodesPath* = 1. Previously coined nNodes in (Duriez2021b) :param int nodesPath: defines how the space of spherical coordinates $( theta in [0; pi] , varphi in [0;2 pi])$ is discretized when ray tracing the boundary nodes: 1 gives a rectangular partition of that space, plus two nodes at $ theta = 0 [ pi]$; 2 locates the nodes along a spiral path (Duriez2021a) :param real nodesTol: tolerance coefficient for accepting (if $| phi| / L <$ nodesTol $ times$ numeric precision with $ phi$ the return value of distance and $L$ a body-characteristic length taken as $ sqrt[3]{V}$ with $V$ the volume, or $ sqrt{V/g_{grid}}$ with $g_{grid}$ the grid spacing if twoD) surface nodes proposed by the ray tracing algorithm

methods.name: getSurface
methods.description: Compute particle surface by differentiation of Level Set volume around $ phi = 0$, where best results have usually been obtained using smearCoeff = 1. Given argument *epsilon* (as a length quantity) serves to initialize the recursive limit search in the derivative expression (see (Duriez2025))

methods.name: computeMarchingCubes
methods.description: Compute or recompute the triangulation of the particle surface after using the Marching Cubes algorithm on distField.

methods.name: marchingCubesVertices
methods.description: Returns the vertices for a surface triangulation obtained after executing the Marching Cubes algorithm on distField.

methods.name: marchingCubesNormals
methods.description: Returns the normals for a surface triangulation obtained after executing the Marching Cubes algorithm on distField.

methods.name: marchingCubesNbTriangles
methods.description: Returns the number of triangles forming the surface triangulation as per the Marching Cubes algorithm (executed on distField).

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
